# LETS plugin config
# NOT FOR SECRETS. Contents are injected verbatim into model context every
# session (subject to whitelist filter in lets hook session-start). Put
# tokens/passwords elsewhere (gh auth, OS keychain, .beads/.env).

# Managed by lets - do not edit
LETS_ENV_VERSION=dev

# Default response language — write the English name, like every value here (English, Ukrainian, Russian, Japanese, ...)
LETS_LANGUAGE=Ukrainian

# Target branch for merges and PR base
LETS_MERGE_BRANCH=main

# PR flow: github | bitbucket | local
LETS_PR_FLOW=local

# Task tracker adapter: beads | none (selects .claude/rules/tracker-<name>.md)
LETS_TRACKER=beads

# Worktree launcher: terminal (print the cd command) | cmux (cmux workspace, macOS only) | tmux (tmux window/session, Linux + macOS) | orca (Orca app worktree + agent, falls back to cmux/terminal; also the one switch for every Orca integration: card, /lets:hub, /lets:team orca backend)
LETS_LAUNCHER=terminal

# Where this project's workflow rules come from: project (own .claude/rules copy) | user (rely on the ~/.claude/rules global copy)
LETS_RULES_SCOPE=project

# How the sessions LETS launches start: default (plain claude; also what empty means) | auto (--permission-mode auto) | all-in (--permission-mode bypassPermissions - set it only on purpose; match the class your orchestrator runs in)
LETS_LAUNCH_MODE=

# Which actions ask you first: strict (every commit and confirm, as before 0.11) | standard (irreversible or outward only: PR merge, force-push, destructive, a push or PR outside /lets:done, tracker close outside /lets:done, bd dolt push, posting outside the repo, other projects, release) | minimal (as standard, except a push or PR outside /lets:done asks only for the merge branch or another task's branch, and /lets:done merges the task's own PR once CI is green). The full table: core rules ## Gates. Written only by /lets:init or by you; read at session start
LETS_GATES=
